name: nine-engines
description: Explainable pipeline engine allocation and sales capacity for AI startups: company parameters in, budgeted engine verdicts, staffing math, and a weekly operating loop out. A human approves every external send.

interface.shortDescription: Pipeline engine allocation and sales capacity, explainable.
interface.longDescription: Feed it your company parameters (ACV, cycle, team, budget, constraints) and it returns nine engine verdicts with written reasons, an exact budget split, a tested sales-capacity check against your ARR target, and a Monday-to-Friday operating loop. Deterministic models, pinned fixtures, field-validated inputs. Built by Andrew Wesbecher from the playbook at wesbecher.llc/pipeline.
